question: How many orders has each customer placed? Show the customer name and the count.
sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(o.id) FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.name

question: What is the total revenue from captured payments?
sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM payments WHERE status = 'captured'

question: Show the average review rating for each product name, including only products that have at least one review.
sql: SELECT p.name, AVG(r.rating) FROM products p JOIN reviews r ON r.product_id = p.id GROUP BY p.name
notes: Originally ambiguous: a LEFT JOIN reading returning all 12 products is equally defensible. A stronger model chose that reading and was scored wrong, which was a defect in the question, not the answer.

question: List each category name with its number of products, sorted by count descending then by name ascending.
sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(p.id) AS product_count FROM categories c JOIN products p ON p.category_id = c.id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY product_count DESC, c.name ASC

question: What is the total quantity sold for each product name, counting only products that have actually been ordered?
sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.id GROUP BY p.name
notes: Same ambiguity as ag-03: without this the LEFT JOIN reading including never-sold products at 0 is equally correct.

question: Which order ids have more than one line item?
sql: SELECT order_id FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

question: How many orders are there in each order status?
sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY status

question: For each country, what is the highest order total placed by a customer from that country?
sql: SELECT c.country, MAX(o.total) FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.country

question: Which product names have an average review rating below 3?
sql: SELECT p.name FROM products p JOIN reviews r ON r.product_id = p.id GROUP BY p.name HAVING AVG(r.rating) < 3

question: Count how many reviews exist for each rating value, sorted by rating ascending.
sql: SELECT rating, COUNT(*) FROM reviews GROUP BY rating ORDER BY rating ASC
